section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the revision of the original Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) to create the BAS-2. Five of the original 13 items were revised or removed: Item 12 was reworded to eliminate sex-specific language; Items 4 and 13 were revised to remove negatively-biased language about body flaws; and Items 8 and 9 were removed because research shows positive body image involves celebrating rather than ignoring appearance. The revisions reflect a shift toward more affirming and inclusive language in assessing body appreciation.
